comments.author: Visitor
comments.body: The Bermuda Sloop can now be built in Santo Domingo. It apparently costs 16 million ducats, requires R19 Shipbuilding skill and a Large Flush Deck Style Hull, and takes 42 minutes to finish construction. Investment is surely also required, but I cannot check how much due to having invested in the port prior to now.

comments.body: Anyone know positively that this ship the Bermuda Sloop goes up to 6/6?

comments.author: Reina
comments.body:
Santo Domingo does not meet the required development level in order to build a Bermuda Sloop.
In order to be able to build the ship, we will need to raise the Development Level of Santo Domingo to 70000 (now 58972).
This is information from GMmayo (Papayaplay Support Team).
